title.zh: 【PeckShield：Base 上金库攻击事件损失扩大至约 600 万美元】
title.en: 【PeckShield：Base 上金库攻击事件损失扩大至约 600 万美元】

current_state.zh: PeckShield reports that losses from an attack on an unnamed Base vault have grown to approximately $6 million, or about 1,783 wstETH, after an attacker contract was whitelisted and drained aBaswstETH/aTokens across a handful of transactions.
current_state.en: PeckShield reports that losses from an attack on an unnamed Base vault have grown to approximately $6 million, or about 1,783 wstETH, after an attacker contract was whitelisted and drained aBaswstETH/aTokens across a handful of transactions.
